name: TreeView
note: Baselines are regression references. A visual change re-writes them with --approve and needs critic approval (system rule).

critic.notes: Four variants read without narration: plan funnel (rows flow up, cyan pulse beads), IAM decision trace (cyan route, red/green outcome chips with glyphs), fs outline (folder/file glyphs, violet), B+ tree (leaf sibling chain, green search hit). Palette via tokens, Arabic and mixed AR+Latin ('فيه Deny صريح؟') correct. Non-blocking: flat depth (no motes/parallax), inactive wires hairline, plan frame ~45% of frame height, detached wire stub at a1 and f90 SCAN wire, strip of motion requested for round 2. Critic also rendered frames 90/330/385/460 (deleted).
